title: OAU Admission, Post-UTME, Acceptance & School Fees: 2026/27 Guide
summary: OAU's 2026/27 Post-UTME screening registration deadline was extended to 23 September, with physical screening 25–30 September. Its university portal separates screening payment, acceptance, main charges and accommodation; use your own session-specific invoice rather than an old price table.
feeNote: OAU's 2026 notice specifically identifies ₦2,000 screening fee excluding portal access charges. It is NOT acceptance, tuition, main fees or hostel costs. Current school charges vary by faculty and are calculated through the student's university e-portal.
timeline: OAU extended its 2026/27 screening registration through 23 September 2026 and moved physical screening to 25–30 September; those dates have passed.
requirements: 2026 JAMB registration number, an active candidate email and mobile number for OAU application access
OAU first-choice status and UTME score of 200+ for the published 2026/27 Post-UTME candidate route, or the appropriate Direct Entry eligibility
O-level and other examination results consistent with JAMB records, plus documents requested by the university for the candidate's screening category
For admitted students, CAPS admission acceptance, university registration account, and payment references or admission letters needed to generate the relevant invoices
steps: Open OAU's official admission screening notice and confirm the session and whether the screening registration period is active; the 2026/27 deadline of 23 September has passed.
Sign in to the OAU admission portal at eportal2.oauife.edu.ng/ug/admissions and choose Verify your Details, using your JAMB registration number, contact email and phone number.
During an authorised screening period, pay the institution's displayed screening and portal-access charges through its own payment workflow and keep confirmation; do not use an agent.
Check the OAU account for assigned physical screening date and location if applicable, then present the specified original credentials and screening evidence.

After a genuine JAMB CAPS and university admission offer, log into the student e-portal, select Payment of Fees and generate separate applicable slips for acceptance, main tuition/charges and a hostel bedspace only if allocated.
Pay using the official university-generated reference; validate each receipt and complete course registration and the faculty clearance instructions for your session.
notes: The university's 28 August 2026 update superseded the earlier screening date and moved the exercise to 25–30 September; candidates should not rely on the old 1–5 September timetable.
OAU's portal explicitly says acceptance, main school fees and accommodation are distinct payments; accommodation should only be paid after an official bedspace allocation.
The 2025/26 undergraduate finance orientation says charges can differ by faculty and may allow part-payment, but it is not a 2026/27 universal fee schedule.
Never submit original credentials or make payments through a contact claiming to secure a guaranteed admission.

title: FUTA 2026/27 Admission Screening, Student Portal & School Fees
summary: FUTA's 2026/27 Post-UTME and Direct Entry screening fee was ₦2,000 through its Remita-linked application process and registration closed on 31 July. Admitted students use the university student portal for biodata, document verification, school fee invoices and level-officer validation.
feeNote: ₦2,000 is the published 2026/27 screening charge only. Admission acceptance, programme school fees, hostel and administrative charges are separate; the student portal generates the school fee invoice after clearance screening.
timeline: The official screening registration extension ended 31 July 2026; no further admission or individual clearance deadline is inferred.
requirements: FUTA first-choice university JAMB entry with at least 180 UTME score for the stated 2026/27 UTME screening, or an eligible Direct Entry route
Five qualifying O-level credits including English Language and Mathematics within the prescribed number of sittings
Candidates must be 16 by 30 September 2026 under the university's 2026/27 notice and have O-level records correctly uploaded to JAMB CAPS
For admitted students, JAMB admission letter, passport photograph, birth certificate, certificate of local-government origin, result and attestation records for biodata screening
steps: Open FUTA's official 2026/27 Post-UTME extension notice and check the date before attempting registration; the published 31 July screening deadline has passed.
During an active future window, choose the university screening form using the FUTA admission portal and enter the exact JAMB registration number and full name as shown on the JAMB slip.
Generate the screening Remita code from the university application and pay the published application charge only through that authorised reference, keeping a receipt.
Complete the examination grades and admission form and print the screening registration acknowledgement; ensure O-level results are also correctly uploaded to JAMB CAPS.

After admission, use FUTA's student registration portal to upload the listed photo, birth, local-government, results, affidavit, admission-letter and academic documents, then finalise the biodata preview.

Following portal screening, generate the school fee invoice through FUTA's approved Remita flow, confirm payment and report with original evidence to the university level-screening officer for final validation.
notes: FUTA says an applicant whose O-level results are not on JAMB CAPS by the stated 2026 deadline cannot be considered for that cycle.
The university's registration instructions distinguish online document screening from later in-person verification by the level-screening officer.
The university's published October 2026 MBBS status and other programme-specific routes cannot be treated as the fee for every FUTA course.
Do not mistake ₦2,000 Post-UTME registration for the student's final school-fee invoice.

title: UNIPORT 2026/27 Post-UTME, Direct Entry, Fee & Clearance Guide
summary: UNIPORT's 2026/27 Post-UTME and Direct Entry screening announcements published a ₦2,000 Remita payment route. The initial windows and later screening/mop-up exercises have ended; use the official data-capture portal for admission records and wait for course/session-specific clearance and school-fee notices.
feeNote: The official ₦2,000 Post-UTME/Direct Entry charge is a screening fee, not acceptance, school charges or a hostel fee. Current programme-level tuition and fresher clearance amounts require a university portal invoice or subsequent official notice.
timeline: 2026/27 Post-UTME screening was conducted in June with a July 27 mop-up; Direct Entry online registration was announced for 15 May–19 June. Check the official university site for later admission notices.
requirements: UNIPORT selected as first-choice institution, or a completed JAMB change-of-institution to first choice for the applicable 2026 UTME route
The university's 2026/27 Post-UTME notice specifies a minimum UTME score of 160 for its screening route
JAMB registration number, own valid telephone/email address and uploaded O-level examination results on JAMB CAPS
Direct Entry candidates must also provide their qualifying A-level, Diploma, NCE, JUPEB, IJMB or degree results when required
steps: Visit the official UNIPORT admissions/news website and identify the latest relevant 2026/27 UTME or Direct Entry notice; published screening application windows have already closed.
Open the university data-capture portal with your JAMB registration number and verify that your personal details match the candidate record uploaded from JAMB.
During an authorised application period, generate an official Remita payment code through the UNIPORT registration workflow and pay the stated ₦2,000 screening amount, keeping the access code.
Return to the university portal, confirm the payment, enter the academic information and print the photo or registration card showing the designated screening schedule.
Check UNIPORT and JAMB CAPS for an actual admission offer rather than inferring admission from a screening score or a Remita payment.

When the university announces current fresher clearance and school-charge procedures, upload and present its listed certificates, identity documents and receipts and pay only the student-specific invoice.
notes: A later 2026/27 official schedule superseded the initial 29 May registration date and set screening in June; a subsequent university update recorded a 27 July mop-up.

The UNIPORT data-capture portal displays an application-closed message, although its notice may contain a stale old-end-date string. Follow the university's official latest announcement for a future session.
Do not pay an unverified portal, school-fee collection agent or anyone offering admission on a WhatsApp group.
Direct Entry and UTME applicants follow distinct registration and exam or qualification verification routes.

title: Bayero University Kano 2026 Admission, Portal, School Fees & Clearance
summary: Bayero University Kano ran its 2026 UTME aptitude-test registration through BUKAT (extended to 4 October) and Direct Entry screening through BUKDES. New students should accept a verified JAMB CAPS offer, use the separate BUK online screening portal and generate the BUK personalised payment form before fee payment.
feeNote: The BUK 2026 aptitude portal does not establish a universal current 2026/27 payment amount in its visible notice. BUK's ₦10,000 acceptance fee and ₦5,000 late-registration notice were explicitly tied to the 2025/26 academic session; neither proves the 2026/27 charge.
timeline: BUKAT payment registration was extended through 4 October 2026, and BUKDES through 18 August 2026. Both periods have passed; later admission and school-fee processing is controlled by university announcements.
requirements: Candidate's JAMB registration or Direct Entry number, applicable examination score, and matching personal records
O-level results properly uploaded to JAMB, with the official university category and programme eligibility confirmed
For successful candidates, accepted admission on JAMB CAPS and saved JAMB and BUK admission-letter details
BUK Personalised Payment Form (BUKPPF), Remita Retrieval Reference, and active student email/phone for approved school and registration fee payments
steps: Open BUK's official New Student Application Portals index and choose Aptitude Test Registration for UTME or DE Screening for Direct Entry; the 2026 published application windows are closed.
For a newly announced screening period, sign in through the relevant BUKAT or BUKDES portal using your JAMB or Direct Entry number and complete candidate identification.
Check that your O-level results are correctly uploaded on the JAMB portal, then follow only the university-generated personalised invoice and payment reference for the applicable screening.
When JAMB CAPS confirms an offer, accept it and print the JAMB admission letter before starting the university's online screening.
Access BUK Online Screening at mybuk2.buk.edu.ng/myScreening, download the BUK admission and undertaking forms, and generate the personalised payment form for any approved acceptance payment.

Use the university's separate undergraduate registration portal to update contact details, generate the BUKPPF for school charges, pay by official Remita and verify the course registration with the designated level coordinator.
notes: The university's 2025/26 March 2026 bulletin lists a ₦10,000 acceptance payment for that session only. The price is not automatically valid for 2026/27.
BUK's undergraduate portal 2025/26 notice mentions ₦5,000 late registration from July 2026 and level-coordinator approval; it does not determine current admissions or general tuition.
Do not confuse BUKAT for UTME, BUKDES for Direct Entry, online screening for newly admitted students and the undergraduate course-registration system.
The university recommends that payment enquiries include the proper BUKPPF ID and Remita RRR; never share portal passwords with unverified intermediaries.
